changelog:
v3.6.7 — Subtitles Actually Show Now (Compatible Mode)

Subtitles
• Fixed: on the compatible-mode engine, picking a subtitle track would show the track in the Tracks panel but nothing would appear on screen. The engine was never given a subtitle surface to draw into, so subs decoded but had nowhere to paint. Subs now render correctly for MKVs and any other content routed through the compatible engine.
